protocol_notes: FF++ split 7:1:2 train/val/test (NOT the official 720/140/140 split). notes: Cross-dataset FF++(HQ)->Celeb-DF AUC; text says 77.1%. Only cross-dataset result in paper. No DFDC, DeeperForensics, DFD, C40 cross-dataset, Precision/Recall/F1. Code link github.com/hwZHc/TSFF-Net returns 404 (Sep 2026).
